_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase ML pilot). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1). Companion phrase pack: phrases/funk/ (Phase ML). Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Funk
blurb: Classic funk: ghost-note 16th pocket, staccato rootless-9th chank comping, and a greasy root-octave bass that lives on the One.

flavors.label: On The One
flavors.blurb: One chord for the whole loop, everything slammed onto beat one -- the James Brown tunnel.

flavors.label: Meters Strut
flavors.blurb: Two chords of 7ths and dead notes, guitar laying back behind the beat New Orleans style.

flavors.label: Horn Section
flavors.blurb: East Bay tight: dead-on 16th stabs and real changes under the horns, nobody rushing.

flavors.label: P-Funk Stretch
flavors.blurb: Spaced-out and wandering -- eight changes of thick 9ths, played loose and a little drunk.

flavors.label: Slow Burn
flavors.blurb: Half-time and sustained: Rhodes pads instead of chank, the pocket wide open underneath.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Funk harmony is nearly static: one or two chords held for bars while rhythm does the work. Favor dominant 7/9 and minor 7/9 vamps in Mixolydian or Dorian, i7-IV7 two-chord shuttles, and bVI-bVII walk-ups back to i. Avoid ii-V-I cadences and modulation. The groove carries the tune, not the changes.
